text:
lina: Heads-up: saw a weird p99-only bump for /v1/generate at ~08:02 UTC. p50 unchanged, p95 +15ms, p99 +110ms. Could be routing/provenance issue.

mike: I noticed that as well. We shifted a tiny routing weight for eu-west yesterday but that shouldn't only affect p99.

ashley: mobile-ios canary ramped yesterday morning; maybe gateway queues spiking for high-priority.

sangeet: Do we currently tag sample_origin in all emitted samples? If not, dashboards could be mixing gateway_total and backend_proc.

lina: The console label says "service_time" with no origin info  that's ambiguous and likely the root cause.

mike: Quick check: pulled raw samples for the 15m window. backend_proc_ms p99 = 320ms, gateway_total_ms p99 = 445ms. High-priority queue subset shows the larger gap.

paul: Are those raw samples or tdigest rollups? Rollup artifacts can make tails look worse across shards.
mike: raw samples from sample_store. Not a rollup artifact.

ops-bot: Autoscaler event: scaled +2 dedicated workers in eu-west-1 at 07:58 UTC.

ashley: scaling after spike suggests a capacity knee. But we still need clearer metric semantics in the UI.

devx: UX proposal: add a small provenance badge on the latency pane that shows metric origin (gateway/backend/combined) and a checkbox toggle "include queue time" default off. Hover text explains exact fields.

sangeet: From infra: we don't reliably emit sample_origin yet. I can add sample_origin and queue_time_ms to the sample schema, open a PR today, and announce. Migration will need docs.

paul: Operational ask: add a runbook step to inspect queue_time_histogram and sample_origin breakdown whenever route p99 > baseline + threshold to avoid noisy pages.

mike: Engineering note: console currently plots service_time_ms with no origin tag. I can change the default to backend_proc_ms until provenance exists, and add a metric-legend that users can click to switch to gateway_total_ms.

devx: Also add a "view raw samples" link from the provenance pill so SEs can repro tail cases. Include unit tests to ensure toggles keep time range and aggregation consistent.

lina: Agreed actions: (1) sangeet add sample_origin + queue_time_ms (PR by EOD); (2) mike switch dashboard default to backend_proc_ms + add legend; (3) devx implement provenance badge + raw-sample link + tests; (4) paul add runbook snippet. I'll track on Console UX board.

ashley: tagging @growth-product  this affects mobile canary metrics.

mike: I'll post the side-by-side backend_vs_gateway p99 numbers and a tiny query we used.

sangeet: I'll coordinate the telemetry rollout and include a migration note for SEs.

lina: Thanks team for quick triage. Leaving the thread open for PR links and dashboard patch. :thumbsup:
